authorization: User: go ahead, following the completed design/power assessment and remaining conditions.
scope: New diagnostic calculations on saved aggregate returns; no original source/replay/account/analysis helper reruns.
known_before_diagnostics: All historical returns and V1 power results are development evidence. V1 pooled contrasts are already paired on market dates. Single-seed first-row formatting was inspected, but no new variant precision has been computed.
question: Can an unselected replicate-average comparison materially reduce temporal uncertainty at unchanged per-run portfolio exposure, and is unused confirmation data actually ready?

variants.source: sealed four-block SE from original EFS receipt

variants.role: candidate expected-replicate-performance estimand; no outcome-based trial selection
unbalanced diagnostic only; cannot claim equal search opportunity

return_treatment.aggregation: Compound each saved daily path to all 72 complete months, then average monthly performance across recorded algorithm replicates. This is an expected-replicate-performance statistic, not a newly backtested investable rebalanced ensemble.
return_treatment.require_calendar: Exactly 1510 saved dates and 72 complete 2019-2024 month labels, no dropping/intersection/filling
return_treatment.exposure: No leverage, scale, cash blend, volatility shrinkage or new holdings rule. Each saved full-exposure path is unchanged.

inference.conditioning: Calendar SE conditions on the small recorded seed bank. It does not establish full uncertainty over future searches.
inference.pairing_diagnostic: All six permutations of three grammar seeds; demonstrate that their average paired contrast is invariant. Renaming seed IDs is not common random numbers.
inference.variance_components: Exploratory two-way random-effects method-of-moments on three seeds by four annualized block estimates. Preserve negative component estimates; do not clip them or use them as power certification. Evaluate all six pairings.

validation_data_readiness.historical_inputs: Inspect only existing data provenance and date bounds, not raw unseen outcome rows. Never declare a period unused solely because another filename exists.
validation_data_readiness.forward_route: First market observation must follow a genuinely completed executable-policy and input/selection seal; the current proposal is not that seal. Full data/collector/execution/model-knowledge readiness and sufficient duration remain required.
validation_data_readiness.historical_route: Requires documented non-use in design/model selection and a model-information boundary. No new outcome fetch before that decision.

launch_gate: No new search may launch merely because one exploratory variant has a smaller SE; candidate estimand, joint seed/time uncertainty, equal-opportunity mechanism and fresh-data gates must all be established.
